fixtures.name: ETH or SETH assumption promoted to an unconditional theorem
fixtures.invalid_inference: ETH rules out polynomial SAT, therefore P differs from NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: ETH is a stronger unproved hypothesis whose truth would already imply P differs from NP.
fixtures.witness: A conditional lower bound cannot be used as an unconditional separation.
fixtures.remediation: Mark every conclusion conditional on ETH or prove the hypothesis independently.

fixtures.name: Average-case hardness promoted to worst-case hardness
fixtures.invalid_inference: A problem is hard under one distribution, therefore it is outside P in the worst case, or conversely.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The distribution, reduction, success probability, and direction of transfer are unspecified.
fixtures.witness: Distributional and worst-case problems have different quantifiers.
fixtures.remediation: Supply a formal worst-case-to-average-case or average-case-to-worst-case theorem.

fixtures.name: VP versus VNP promoted to classical P versus NP
fixtures.invalid_inference: VP differs from VNP, therefore P differs from NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The algebraic and Boolean models are distinct and no general equivalence theorem is known.
fixtures.witness: Algebraic circuit size and Boolean decision time measure different objects.
fixtures.remediation: Keep the algebraic result separate or prove a precise transfer for the selected family.

fixtures.name: GCT obstruction programme promoted to a completed separation
fixtures.invalid_inference: Geometric Complexity Theory provides the desired obstructions, so P differs from NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The required explicit occurrence obstructions and transfer to the terminal Boolean target are not established.
fixtures.witness: A research programme and a conditional obstruction framework are not terminal theorem certificates.
fixtures.remediation: Name the exact proved obstruction and its model-level consequence.

fixtures.name: MCSP completeness or hardness asserted without the reduction
fixtures.invalid_inference: MCSP is NP-complete or its lower bound automatically yields P versus NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The exact representation, reduction type, promise, and transfer theorem are absent.
fixtures.witness: MCSP's complexity depends critically on truth-table input length and the selected reduction notion.
fixtures.remediation: State only the source-backed MCSP theorem and retain all representation and reduction qualifiers.

fixtures.name: Magnification premise hidden by the dramatic conclusion
fixtures.invalid_inference: A tiny lower bound would imply a breakthrough, therefore the tiny lower bound is easy or already available.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The premise may itself encode the central difficulty under a compressed parameter regime.
fixtures.witness: Magnification transfers hardness; it does not guarantee the triggering lower bound.
fixtures.remediation: Audit the premise as an independent theorem target with its own barriers.

fixtures.name: Current preprint promoted beyond its audited model
fixtures.invalid_inference: A recent frontier preprint is treated as an unrestricted terminal lower bound or as settled literature.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Peer-review status, exact class, advice, depth, gate set, and theorem hypotheses are suppressed.
fixtures.witness: The 2026 frontier records concern restricted models or barrier refinements, not the terminal P-versus-NP statement.
fixtures.remediation: Preserve source maturity and all theorem qualifiers; refresh the audit before promotion.

fixtures.name: Analog constant or infinite precision encodes the answer
fixtures.invalid_inference: A real-number or analog device performs polynomially many operations and decides SAT.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The model grants infinite precision, noncomputable constants, or uncharged measurement accuracy.
fixtures.witness: One real constant can encode an infinite advice sequence in its binary expansion.
fixtures.remediation: Translate the method to the WP00 finite-string bit-cost model and charge precision.

fixtures.name: Succinct input expanded without charging representation size
fixtures.invalid_inference: An algorithm polynomial in the expanded graph, formula, or truth table is polynomial in the succinct input.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The expanded object can be exponentially larger than its encoding.
fixtures.witness: A circuit can succinctly describe a truth table with exponentially many entries.
fixtures.remediation: Measure time in the original encoding length or prove a polynomial expansion bound.

fixtures.name: Learned solver performance promoted to an exact universal algorithm
fixtures.invalid_inference: A neural or learned solver generalizes across benchmark distributions, therefore SAT is in P.
fixtures.missing_obligation: There is no total correctness proof, worst-case polynomial bound, or coverage of all encodings.
fixtures.witness: Adversarial instances can lie outside the training and test distributions.
fixtures.remediation: Treat the system as a heuristic until an exact algorithm and proof satisfy WP00.
